cases.input: the and of to in for on with by at from as is are was were be been
cases.note: Common English function words are kept because the tokenizer has no stopword list
Inflected forms stay distinct because the tokenizer has no stemmer
Underscores are not word characters and split snake_case identifiers into words
Hyphens between ordinary words split hyphenated compounds into their component words
ASCII and curly apostrophes and quotation marks including guillemets split or strip cleanly
Section sign, pilcrow, bullet, horizontal ellipsis and three ASCII dots are non-word separators
Euro, pound, yen and dollar currency signs are stripped while comma-grouped numbers stay intact
Ordinal numbers fail the number shape boundary because of the trailing letters and are taken whole by the word shape
Digits and letters with no separator form a single word token regardless of whether digits or letters come first
Integers with one or more three-digit comma groups match the number shape and strip every comma
Decimal numbers with one, two, three or four fractional digits keep their decimal point and strip thousands commas
Commas that are not followed by exactly three digits and a non-digit do not join into the number token
Trailing dots, leading dots and double dots are not part of a number; 1.2.3 has two .[0-9]+ groups and stays one number token
When a comma or decimal number is immediately followed by a letter, the number shape fails the boundary check without backtracking and the word shape takes the leading digits
Slashes, dots and hashes in a file path or URL fragment separate path segments while preserving an embedded claim id
URL punctuation separates scheme, host and query parameters while the clause number in the path still matches
Backticks, colons, asterisks, underscores and tildes are stripped around words
ASCII operators, angle brackets, braces, pipes, tildes and carets separate word tokens; duplicates are removed on the query side
A string containing every ASCII punctuation and symbol character and no alphanumerics yields no tokens
Leading zeros on integer tokens are preserved verbatim
Zero digits in comma groups and fractional parts are preserved after stripping commas
Colons, percent signs, commas after numbers and dollar signs separate cleanly in prose
Underscore-separated form names split into words and numbers while unseparated sf33 stays one word
An ISO timestamp splits on hyphens and colons while the T and Z join with adjacent digits into word tokens
After v1 and the dot, 2.3 has a one-digit fraction so shape 10 takes 2.3, followed by beta and 4
Standalone parenthesised paragraph designators without a leading part.section become ordinary word and number tokens
Non-ASCII alphabetic characters with diaeresis and acute accents are word characters and stay attached to ASCII letters
Three thousands commas and a six-digit decimal fraction are taken as a single number token with commas removed
Runs of hyphens, slashes, dots and spaces with no word characters produce no tokens
